description: List webhook events, most recent first: id, app, type, status, attempt, destination status code, latency, timestamp. Summaries only, no request headers or body — call anyhook_inspect with an id from here to read one event's payload. Uses your AnyHook account when connected, otherwise the local in-memory store.

appSlug.description: Filter to a specific app slug (account mode).

status.description: Filter by status. Account mode: queued|success|retrying|failed|rejected|circuit_open|quota_exceeded. Local mode: received|forwarded|failed|retrying.

name: anyhook_events
title: List recent webhook events
